items.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
items.reason: Gemini Decisions API: a new closed-set-scoring endpoint (probabilities/confidence over up to 1000 questions in one multimodal call) that is 5x cheaper than Flash-Lite and gives calibrated confidence scores — a genuine eval/calibration infra story, not just another chat model.
key_facts: Up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice (2-255 options) or rubric-score questions per request, multimodal input up to 256K tokens
150-250ms end-to-end latency, flat from 1 to 100 questions
$0.10 per 1M input tokens, $0 for output tokens (scores options in one forward pass, no generation)
~5x cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite via Interactions API on vendor's benchmark suite
Every answer carries a 0-1 confidence score for routing ambiguous cases to a human/fallback
Gemini Notebook reports up to 40% lower latency using it as a model router

items.title: Attacker Used 4,837 Hijacked GitHub Accounts to Run a CI Secret Stealer in 1,806+ Repositories
items.reason: Large-scale supply-chain campaign: 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts ran a CI secret-stealer across 61,764 repos (test PRs) and at least 1,806 confirmed-compromised repos, hitting cloud/CI secrets and persisting via rewritten IAM trust policies — big and concrete, but the reporting shows no AI/automation angle beyond the attack's own scale, so it only qualifies as a large pure-cyber headline, not an AI story.
key_facts: 4,837 accounts used stolen credentials to open a test PR ('docs: dependency audit notes') checking write access across 61,764 repos
At least 1,806 repos actually ran the CI secret stealer (Aikido); SafeDep separately counted 8,093 repos receiving malicious commits
Stealer targets Actions secrets, GITHUB_TOKEN/OIDC, and AWS/Azure/GCP/K8s/npm/PyPI/SSH credentials; exfiltrates via HTTP POST or Telegram
Persistence: rewrites AWS role trust policies, creates long-lived IAM keys, adds Azure federated creds prefixed 'wfx-ci-'
Downstream package compromise confirmed in a Packagist package, two Go modules, and 28 WebdriverIO repos
Accounts hit in October's GhostAction campaign were ~1,000x more likely to be reused here, though Aikido does not attribute it to the same actor

items.title: Chinese frontier AI models carry the fingerprint of export-controlled GPUs
items.reason: Rigorous independent forensic method (PyTorch Philox RNG seed/thread-count fingerprinting of published weights) identifies five 2026 Chinese frontier models as Blackwell-initialized despite export controls, with results in the 49-1,385 sigma range and validation against 24 disclosed-hardware cases and physical GPU reproduction — real evaluation/provenance methodology with numbers, not a rumor.

Strongest per-model result 49-1,385 sigma; chance-match baseline across ~6 trillion seed/layout combos is ~8 sigma
Verified by reproducing weights on real hardware: B300 matched 461/469 DeepSeek-V4-Flash rows; H100 matched all 57,344 preserved DeepSeek-V3 values bit-for-bit

CPU streaming time-to-first-audio (p95): 28ms (31m English), 38ms (40m English), vs 165ms for Pocket TTS
ptts inference framework supports 10+ backends across CPU/GPU/NPU; runs offline on phone/laptop/SBC/browser
200,000+ downloads in first two weeks
